reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Kubernetes: Due to the use of apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions, prometheus-operator requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: Upgrade to prometheus-operator 0.86.0 will fail on Kubernetes clusters earlier than v1.16.0, as the operator requires apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions which are only available in Kubernetes >= v1.16.0.

proposed.statement: prometheus-operator 0.86.0 requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0 due to the use of apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions.
